nodes.title: Start here
widgets_values:
{"version": 1, "tone": "icon", "look": "card", "step": 1, "icon": "flag", "text": "### One image, step by step

Every run rolls a new character and scene from the lists in the two **WP Context** nodes, writes the prompt and makes one image. Nothing has to be in your library: the lists come with this workflow.

| Key | Step |
|---|---|
| `Alt+1` | Pick the character |
| `Alt+2` | Write the prompt |
| `Alt+3` | Pick a checkpoint and run |
| `Alt+4` | LoRAs and switches (optional) |
| `Alt+5` | Settings from the model (optional) |
| `Alt+6` | The image |

:pi-bookmark: Jump with the keys or the **Bookmarks** dock (top bar).

:pi-lightbulb:{#22c55e} New to ComfyUI? [ComfyUI's first-image guide](https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/basic/text-to-image){button pi-external-link #eab308}

---

**Questions, ideas, packs to share:**

[Discord](https://discord.gg/BFYR9WQdVR){button pi-discord #5865f2} [Community packs](https://wp.dumiflex.dev){button pi-globe #22c55e} [Wiki](https://github.com/DumiFlex/ComfyUI-Wildcard-Pipeline/wiki){button pi-github #8b949e} [About these examples](docs:howto-examples){button pi-th-large}", "color": "", "bookmark": null}

nodes.title: Pick the character
widgets_values:
{"version": 1, "tone": "step", "look": "card", "step": 1, "icon": "info-circle", "text": "Each **WP Context** holds a **bundle**: a pack of lists that work together. Click a bundle header to open it.

- A **list** (wildcard) picks one option per run and writes a `$variable`.
- **Sub-bundles** like *Look* and *Outfit* group lists inside a bundle.
- **Shared lists** is switched off on purpose: other lists read its colours through an `@{Colors}` reference, it adds no words itself.

:pi-tag: The grey **EXAMPLE** chip means the bundle lives only in this workflow.

nodes.title: Inside the Scene bundle
widgets_values:
{"version": 1, "tone": "icon", "look": "card", "step": 1, "icon": "sitemap", "text": "The chip on each row says what it does:

| Row | What it does |
|---|---|
| **constraint** | *Hero fits the place* reads the hero picked in the first Context, so a knight lands in a castle more often |
| **derivation** | night brings lantern light and its own negative words |
| **combine** | joins setting, time and light into `$scene` |
| **fixed** | the style, the same every run |

[Constraints](docs:constraint){button pi-book} [Derivations](docs:derivation){button pi-directions}", "color": "teal", "bookmark": null}

nodes.title: LoRAs and switches (optional, all off)
widgets_values:
{"version": 1, "tone": "icon", "look": "card", "step": 1, "icon": "sliders-h", "text": "**WP Toggles** is the switchboard for this workflow:

1. Pick a LoRA in a **Load LoRA** node and type its trigger words in the boxes.
2. Switch it on. The switch un-bypasses its loader *and* tells the **LoRA swaps** bundle to use the words: a character's replace `$hero` (and, with *Use its own clothes*, `$outfit`), a style's go after `$style`.
3. *Settings from the model* bypasses that whole group when off.

> The toggles write `$lora_character`… as true / false; the **Injector** writes the words to their own variables (`$lora_hero_words`…), so a switch never prints.

[WP Toggles](docs:wp-toggles){button pi-sliders-h} [Injector](docs:wp-context-injector){button pi-sign-in}

[Find LoRAs on Civitai](https://civitai.com/models?types=LORA){button pi-search #3b82f6} [ComfyUI LoRA guide](https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/basic/lora){button pi-book #eab308}", "color": "violet", "bookmark": {"anchor": "custom", "view": {"x": 1190, "y": 1810}, "zoomMode": "fixed", "zoom": 0.6, "shortcut": "Alt+4", "order": 4}}
